tree.text:
Sizes
  Inventory window 600x480 (was 760x610), radius 24, pad 20. Slots 72, gap 8 / 10, 7 columns, 4 rows (3 with a footer).
  Bookmark tabs 50x42 (selected 58x42, panel colour, merges with the window), 48px apart, stick out 42px on the left, icon 32.
  Item Card 280 wide, pad 16, nub 12x20. Action buttons: height 48 fixed, label + divider + cost on one line; icon buttons 48x48.

Tabs: All, Fish, Rods, Lines, Auras, Baits, Treasure. Red dot = new items in that tab. Empty slot = 3 small bubbles on sand (option 5).
  Footer only where it has a job:
  Fish / All = SELL ALL, Auras = ROLL AURA + AURA DEX, Treasure = OPEN ALL, others no footer (grid gets the 4th row).

Bags: ladder Starter Pouch 6, Woven Basket 10, Fish Crate 15, Ice Coolbox 20, Ship's Hold 30 (coins), Bottomless Bag = unlimited, Robux only (the Infinite Bag pass, 349 R$). Capacity pill hides UPGRADE once the bag is Bottomless.

Character v2: no Bag slot any more (bag is an upgrade, shown as the capacity pill). Equipped row = Rod, Line, Bait, Aura. Right side = owned items of the tab; tapping any slot (owned grid or equipped row) opens the same Item Card.
